ja287:1.1: He who is mad, slanderous, an actor, who creates a commotion,
ja287:1.3: Gains are received amongst the fools,
ja287:1.4: this is my instruction to you.
ja287:2.1: Cursed be those gains of fame and those gains of wealth, O brahmin,
ja287:2.3: Whatever livelihood is gained through destruction or wrong living.
ja287:3.1: If taking up a bowl and without a home I would wander forth,
ja287:3.3: That life is surely better than seeking out whatever is wrong.
